import.title: Import
import.empty.heading: Bring in your existing wholesale customers
import.empty.body: Upload a spreadsheet, or turn customers with a tag such as wholesale into B2B companies.
import.locked: CSV import and tag conversion are part of the Pro plan.
import.csv.heading: Import from a spreadsheet
import.csv.body: Upload a CSV file with one company per row, up to {max} rows. Nothing is created until you check the rows and confirm.
import.tag.heading: Turn tagged customers into companies
import.tag.body: Customers with these tags become B2B companies with their own location, and are added to the tier you choose. Customers who already belong to a company are skipped.
import.tag.noTiers: Create a tier first, so converted customers have somewhere to go.
import.tag.tagsHelp: For example: wholesale. Separate several tags with commas.
import.tag.exemptionsHelp: Shopify exemption codes, for example US_TX_RESELLER_EXEMPTION. Separate several with commas.
import.tag.sendWelcome: Send each buyer Shopify's B2B access email
import.tag.preview: {count, plural, one {# customer has these tags.} other {# customers have these tags.}}
import.tag.previewCapped: More than {count} customers have these tags. They're all converted in batches.
import.tag.confirmHeading: {count, plural, one {Convert # customer into a company?} other {Convert # customers into companies?}}
import.tag.confirmBody: Customers tagged {tags} become B2B companies in the {tier} tier. This runs in batches and continues if you leave this page. Companies created in Shopify stay there if you uninstall Tradepass.
import.runs.heading: Previous imports
import.map.heading: Match your columns
import.map.body: Tell Tradepass which column holds each detail. We matched the ones we recognised.
import.map.requiredError: Choose the column that holds this detail.
import.map.missing: {count, plural, one {# required detail has no column.} other {# required details have no column.}}
import.options.heading: Import options
import.options.defaultTierHelp: Rows with a tier name use that tier instead.
import.options.noDefaultTier: No default (rows must name a tier)
import.options.existing: When the company already exists in Shopify
import.options.existingLink: Add it to Tradepass and assign the tier
import.options.sendWelcome: Send each buyer Shopify's B2B access email
import.dry.heading: Dry run
import.dry.ready: {count, plural, one {# row is ready to import} other {# rows are ready to import}}
import.dry.errors: {count, plural, one {# row has errors and will be left out} other {# rows have errors and will be left out}}
import.dry.skipped: {count, plural, one {# row will be skipped because the company already exists} other {# rows will be skipped because the company already exists}}
import.dry.warnings: {count, plural, one {# row has warnings} other {# rows have warnings}}
import.dry.note: Fix errors in your file and upload it again, or import the ready rows now.
import.start.heading: {count, plural, one {Import # company?} other {Import # companies?}}
import.start.body: {count, plural, one {# company is created in Shopify with its location and contact, and added to its tier.} other {# companies are created in Shopify with their locations and contacts, and added to their tiers.}} The import runs in batches and continues if you leave this page.
import.progress.heading: Progress
import.progress.label: Import progress
import.progress.resume: You can leave this page. The import continues in the background and picks up where it stopped.
import.cancel.heading: Cancel this import?
import.cancel.body: {done, plural, one {The # company already created stays in Shopify.} other {The # companies already created stay in Shopify.}} The remaining rows won't be imported.
import.issues.heading: {count, plural, one {# issue} other {# issues}}
import.issues.more: {count, plural, one {# more issue is in the error report.} other {# more issues are in the error report.}}
import.issue.invalid_country: Use a 2-letter country code, such as US or DE.
import.issue.zone_required: Add the state or province code for this country.
import.issue.invalid_phone: The phone number isn't valid, so it's left out. Use the international format, such as +15125550100.
import.issue.no_tier: Add a tier name, or choose a tier for rows without one.
import.issue.unknown_terms: No payment terms have this name, so none are set.
import.issue.invalid_exemption: One of the tax exemption codes isn't a Shopify exemption.
import.issue.duplicate_in_file: This appears earlier in the file.
import.issue.existing_company: A company with this name already exists in Shopify.
import.issue.existing_customer: A customer with this email exists and becomes the company contact.
import.issue.customer_in_company: This customer already belongs to a company.
import.issue.already_buyer: This company is already a Tradepass buyer, so it's skipped.
import.issue.no_address: The customer has no default address with street, city and country, so no company was created.
import.issue.step_failed: Shopify didn't accept part of this buyer's setup. Check the activity log.
import.issue.failed: This row couldn't be imported. Check the activity log.
import.error.plan: CSV import is part of the Pro plan.
import.error.noFile: Choose a CSV file to upload.
import.error.file.too_large: The file is larger than 2 MB. Split it into smaller files.
import.error.file.too_many_rows: The file has more rows than the limit. Split it into smaller files.
import.error.file.empty: The file has a header row but no data.
import.error.exemption: Use Shopify exemption codes, such as US_TX_RESELLER_EXEMPTION.
